question: no compass and its sunny. how do i use a stick to find which way is north
keyPoints: Put a stick in level ground and mark the shadow tip; that first mark is west
Wait 10-15 minutes and mark the tip again (east)
The line between is east-west; with west on your left, north is in front

cite.quote: This first shadow mark is always the West direction

question: did the stick shadow thing, which of my two marks is east
keyPoints: The second mark is east (the first is always west)

cite.quote: the first shadow-tip mark is always in the west direction, and the second mark in the east direction

question: my buddy fell on rocks and a patch of his ribs moves in when the rest moves out when he breathes. what do i do
keyPoints: This is a flail chest: broken ribs, breathing is hard and there may be internal bleeding
A bulky dressing wrapped to hold that section still can help
Get emergency help / evacuation
redFlags: Tells them to press hard on or push the ribs back in

cite.quote: Detect "flail chest" by observing a section of ribs moving in and out opposite to the rest of the ribs

question: theres a hole in his chest that bubbles and makes a sucking sound
keyPoints: A sucking chest wound: seal it with an airtight (occlusive) dressing over the entry and exit wounds right away
Taped airtight dressing; get urgent help
redFlags: Leaves the wound open or packs it

cite.quote: requires application of an occlusive dressing to the entry and exit wounds immediately

question: hot red spot on my heel 5 miles in, not a blister yet. what now
keyPoints: That's a hotspot, the start of a blister from friction
Deal with the friction now: keep feet dry, check fit, two pairs of socks; check feet often

cite.quote: At first there is a red, sore area called a hotspot

question: how do i actually strike a ferro rod so the sparks land in the tinder
keyPoints: Hold the rod's end firmly on or near the tinder on a secure base
Striker at 90 degrees, pushed down firmly along the rod

question: phone battery's no good for calls but could a car battery start a fire
keyPoints: Yes: vehicle or equipment batteries can start a fire

cite.quote: Batteries found in vehicles, aircraft, or electronic equipment can be used as a field-expedient firestarter

question: we're starving and got a vulture. ok to eat?
keyPoints: Carrion birds like vultures must be boiled at least 20 minutes to kill parasites before further cooking
Cook bird meat fully; wash hands and tools after
redFlags: Says it can be eaten rare or raw

cite.quote: Carrion eating birds, such as vultures, must be boiled for at least 20 minutes

question: should i skin a duck before cooking it
keyPoints: Most birds are cooked with the skin left on
Only sea birds taste better with the oily skin removed

cite.quote: Most birds except sea birds should be cooked with their skin left on

question: found something that looks like wild carrot. how do i not mix it up with hemlock
keyPoints: Wild carrot / Queen Anne's lace has hairy stems
Poison hemlock has smooth hollow stalks with purple blotches and no hairs
Hemlocks smell nasty when leaves are crushed; wild carrot root smells like carrot
Don't eat it unless sure: the look-alikes are deadly
redFlags: Says it's safe to eat without checking

cite.quote: Poison Hemlock (has smooth hollow stalks with purple blotches and no hairs on its stems)

question: its night, the moon came up before sunset. which side is lit
keyPoints: If the moon rises before the sun sets, the lit side is west

cite.quote: If the moon rises before the sun has set, the illuminated side will be the west

question: can't make out the little dipper, too faint. other ways to find the north star?
keyPoints: Use the Big Dipper or Cassiopeia (the Lazy W) to locate Polaris
The Little Dipper's stars are dim and hard to see near lights

cite.quote: Use them to locate Polaris, also known as the polestar or the North Star

question: cut a vine and liquid is coming out, it tastes kinda sour. drink it?
keyPoints: No: avoid vines whose liquid tastes sour or bitter
Only liquid that doesn't change colour and tastes woody or sweet is safe

question: feet have been wet and cold for two days, theyre pale and numb. should i warm them by the fire
keyPoints: No direct heat: numb feet burn easily

question: car went off the forest road, driver says his neck hurts. pull him out?
keyPoints: Don't move someone with a possible neck or back injury unless there's immediate danger like fire

redFlags: Tells them to pull him out right away with no danger present

question: shirt melted onto a burn on his arm. pull it off?

question: got a dry powder chemical on my skin from a camp cleaner and its burning

question: kid fell and cut his head, bleeding a lot from the scalp. how hard should i press

question: what temperatures does frostbite happen at
